parameters.name: UI_STYLE
parameters.desc: Button layout: 0 = ramp (smooth dimming), 1 = modes (fixed steps), 2 = simple (modes capped at SIMPLE_MAX, no turbo or blinkies)

parameters.name: PREVIEW
parameters.desc: 1 = the light shows the floor level while the button is pressed from off (instant feedback)

parameters.name: CLICK_MS
parameters.desc: Longest press that counts as a click, and the longest pause between clicks of one gesture

parameters.name: RAMP_FLOOR
parameters.desc: Lowest level of the ramp (moon); also used for momentary moon

parameters.name: RAMP_CEIL
parameters.desc: Highest level reached by holding the button; turbo is above it

parameters.name: RAMP_MS
parameters.desc: Time per level while ramping (150 levels x 16 ms = 2.4 s for the whole ramp)

parameters.name: MODE_CNT
parameters.desc: Number of fixed modes in the modes and simple layouts

parameters.name: MODE_1
parameters.desc: Level of mode 1

parameters.name: MODE_2
parameters.desc: Level of mode 2

parameters.name: MODE_3
parameters.desc: Level of mode 3

parameters.name: MODE_4
parameters.desc: Level of mode 4

parameters.name: MODE_5
parameters.desc: Level of mode 5

parameters.name: MODE_MS
parameters.desc: Interval between mode steps while the button is held (modes layout)

parameters.name: MEMORY
parameters.desc: Switch-on level: 1 = the last level used, 0 = always MEM_LEVEL (or mode 1)

parameters.name: MEM_LEVEL
parameters.desc: Switch-on level when MEMORY = 0 (ramp layout)

parameters.name: TURBO_LVL
parameters.desc: Turbo level (double click)

parameters.name: TURBO_S
parameters.desc: Longest turbo burst before the automatic step-down to TURBO_DOWN; 0 = no time limit (the thermal limit always applies)

parameters.name: TURBO_DOWN
parameters.desc: Level after the turbo time has run out

parameters.name: SIMPLE_MAX
parameters.desc: Highest level available in the simple layout (for lending the light to others)

parameters.name: SMOOTH_MS
parameters.desc: Soft transitions: time per level when the brightness changes; 0 = instant

parameters.name: BLINK_LVL
parameters.desc: Brightness used for battery and temperature read-outs

parameters.name: BLINKY
parameters.desc: Blinky modes after the battery check: 1 = beacon, 2 = SOS, 4 = strobe (add the numbers; 0 = none)

parameters.name: STROBE_HZ
parameters.desc: Strobe frequency; flashing between 3 and 30 Hz can trigger photosensitive seizures

parameters.name: LOCK_MOON
parameters.desc: In lockout, holding the button gives momentary moon (0 = lockout stays completely dark)

parameters.name: AUTOLOCK
parameters.desc: Lock automatically after this many minutes off; 0 = never

parameters.name: POCKET_S
parameters.desc: Pocket protection: a button held this long while the main LED is on switches the light off and locks it; 0 = off

parameters.name: AUX_MODE
parameters.desc: Indicator LED: 0 = off, 1 = events and charging only, 2 = also the battery colour for 2 s after switch-on

parameters.name: THM_LIMIT
parameters.desc: Temperature the regulator holds (sensor reading + THM_OFFSET); set it so that the hottest touchable surface stays within THM-1 (docs/design-rules.md)

parameters.name: THM_OFFSET
parameters.desc: Calibration: added to the sensor reading so that it reads the true temperature at the sensor (kept by the factory reset)

parameters.name: THM_KP
parameters.desc: Proportional gain of the thermal regulator

parameters.name: THM_KI
parameters.desc: Integral gain of the thermal regulator (cannot be 0: the regulator always acts)

parameters.name: THM_LEAD
parameters.desc: Prediction: the regulator acts on temperature + rate of rise x THM_LEAD, to make up for sensor lag

parameters.name: THM_FLOOR
parameters.desc: Lowest level the thermal regulator may force (below it only THM_SHUTDN acts)

parameters.name: THM_UP
parameters.desc: Fastest brightness recovery while the light cools down

parameters.name: THM_SHUTDN
parameters.desc: Hard limit: the light switches off and stays off until 5 degC cooler

parameters.name: BAT_CELLS
parameters.desc: Number of cells in series

parameters.name: BAT_CHEM
parameters.desc: Chemistry for the charge estimate: 0 = Li-ion (3.7 V), 1 = LiFePO4 (3.2 V), 2 = NiMH (1.2 V)

parameters.name: LVP_WARN
parameters.desc: Below this voltage (under load) the light steps down

parameters.name: LVP_CUT
parameters.desc: Below this voltage the light switches off to protect the cell (never below 2700 mV for Li-ion, 2000 mV for LiFePO4, 900 mV for NiMH, whatever is set)

parameters.name: LVP_RESUME
parameters.desc: After a low-voltage cut-off the light can be switched on again once the cell rests above this

parameters.name: BAT_RINT
parameters.desc: Resistance of cell, springs and wiring, for the load compensation of the charge estimate

parameters.name: BAT_CAL
parameters.desc: Calibration: added to the measured pack voltage (kept by the factory reset)

parameters.name: BAT_MAX_MA
parameters.desc: Cell current limit, 0 = off (needs the board's LED current model, LX_MAIN_MAX_MA)

parameters.name: CHG_TMIN
parameters.desc: Charging is paused below this temperature (Li-ion must not be charged below 0 degC)

parameters.name: CHG_TMAX
parameters.desc: Charging is paused above this temperature

parameters.name: CHG_MAXLVL
parameters.desc: Highest level while USB power is connected

parameters.name: LASER_EN
parameters.desc: Allow the laser gesture (click, then click-and-hold from off)

parameters.name: LASER_S
parameters.desc: Longest laser emission per press

parameters.name: LASER_TMAX
parameters.desc: No laser above this temperature

parameters.name: LASER_VMIN
parameters.desc: No laser below this cell voltage (cheap laser modules drift when the supply sags)

parameters.name: SIDE_RED
parameters.desc: Brightness of the red side light (5 clicks from off)

parameters.name: SIDE_UV
parameters.desc: Brightness of the UV side light; 0 = no UV (two clicks in the side light then do nothing)

parameters.name: COLOR_SET
parameters.desc: Colours that two clicks step through in the colour beam: 1 = red, 2 = green, 4 = blue, 8 = yellow, 16 = cyan, 32 = magenta, 64 = white from the three colours, 128 = the custom colour COL_R / COL_G / COL_B (add the numbers)

parameters.name: COL_R
parameters.desc: Custom colour: share of the red LED (the strongest of the three runs at the full colour brightness)

parameters.name: COL_G
parameters.desc: Custom colour: share of the green LED

parameters.name: COL_B
parameters.desc: Custom colour: share of the blue LED (red, green and blue all 0 = red)

parameters.name: TURBO_ALL
parameters.desc: 1 = turbo of the white beam also lights the three colour LEDs above the top mode: more lumens, a slightly tinted beam
